card.name: Inside cancer drug names
card.fires_on: The middle piece of certain cancer drug names, mainly the 'SA' ending of ALECENSA and the 'vac' in bevacizumab. Also the 'CH' of CHF in a cancer-drug cardiac-risk passage.
